rationale: Build on the current recurrent-tail QK winner without disturbing the hot training path. The exact roundtrip currently downcasts the small output-side adapters to float16 because they fall under the generic keep-float threshold; this change promotes only logit controls and `bigram_out.weight` to FP32 passthrough, spending leftover artifact headroom on the tensors closest to the final cross-entropy while keeping training, recurrence, quant-aware timing, and exact evaluation otherwise unchanged.
title: FP32 Bigram Output Roundtrip On Recurrent Tail Best
